info.name: Customer Portal
info.description: End-to-end `ROLE_CUSTOMER` API collection: public restaurant & PostGIS geo-catalog discovery, profile & saved GPS addresses, Redis-backed shopping cart & OSRM/Mapbox checkout preview, order placement & tracking, Razorpay/stub payment verification, reviews, notifications, and presigned S3 uploads. Pair with the `Customer Portal - Local Dev` environment.

item.name: Auth & Session Management
User Registration

request.description: Registers a new customer account on the QuickBite platform. (UserRegistrationController#registerCustomer | Public / noauth)

item.description: Public self-registration endpoint (`noauth`) that creates a `ROLE_CUSTOMER` account with Argon2 password hashing (`201 Created`). Follow with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` to start a device session.

item.name: Login & Token Refresh
item.description: Argon2 credential login and silent refresh token rotation (`noauth`). Requires `X-Client-Type: web_browser | mobile_app` and automatically populates `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `challenge_token`, and `session_id` via Postman test scripts.

item.name: Device Session Management
item.description: Resolves `409 Conflict` concurrent session limit challenges using `Authorization: Bearer {{challenge_token}}` (`SCOPE_AUTH`): list active sessions (`GET /sessions`), revoke an old device (`DELETE /sessions/{sessionId}`), and claim the new session (`POST /claim-session`).

item.name: Logout
item.description: Single-device (`/logout`) and global all-device (`/logout-all`) session revocation in PostgreSQL and Redis (`SCOPE_API`), clearing the `refreshToken` cookie.

Authentication and session lifecycle: Argon2 self-registration, dual-audience RSA JWT issuance (`quickbite-api` 15m + `quickbite-auth` 5m), `X-Client-Type`-aware SHA-256 refresh token rotation (`HttpOnly` cookie for `web_browser`, JSON body for `mobile_app`), and Yauaa device session tracking.

item.name: Public Catalog
Cuisines Directory
item.description: Lists all admin-approved cuisine categories available across the platform.

item.name: Restaurant Discovery & Geo-Search
item.description: Browse approved restaurants with cursor pagination (`name`, `cuisineId`, `minRating`) or PostGIS `ST_DWithin` spatial radius queries (`lat`, `lng`, `radius` in metres).

item.name: Public Menu Catalog
item.description: Browse cursor-paginated menu items (`available` filter) and dish details for a specific approved restaurant.

item.name: Public Reviews & Rating Summary
item.description: Publicly visible customer reviews (cursor-paginated) and aggregated 1–5 star rating distribution for a restaurant.

item.name: System Health & Info (Actuator)
item.description: Public Spring Boot Actuator probes (`/actuator/health` and `/actuator/info`) for local diagnostics and readiness checks.

Unauthenticated (`noauth`) read-only endpoints for browsing approved cuisines, searching nearby restaurants via PostGIS `ST_DWithin`, inspecting menus, reading public customer reviews, and checking Spring Boot Actuator health.

item.name: Customer Profile
item.description: View and update the authenticated customer's personal profile (`name`, `phoneNumber`, `email`).

item.name: Shopping Cart

request.description: Calculates real-time price breakdown and order totals (subtotal, delivery fee based on GPS distance, platform fee, taxes, tips, and item discounts) before placing an order.

item.description: Redis-backed single-restaurant shopping cart (`24h` rolling TTL): add/update/remove items, clear cart, and compute live road-distance checkout previews (`GET /checkout-preview`, auto-capturing `total_order_amount`).

item.name: Order Placement & Tracking

request.description: NOTE: Before placing order. First do Checkout Preview so that you will get final amount set into the collection variable automatically using script.
Fetches contact information and live coordinates of the delivery agent assigned to the customer's order. (CustomerOrderController#getAssignedDeliveryAgent | ROLE_CUSTOMER)

item.description: Convert the active cart into an Order (`UPI`, `CARD`, `NET_BANKING`, `WALLET`, `COD`) with `expectedTotal` price-drift protection (`409 Conflict`), track order status history & assigned courier, retry failed payments within the 10-minute window, or cancel pre-acceptance orders.

item.name: Online Payment Verification
item.description: Inspect payment attempts for an order or cryptographically verify Razorpay checkout signatures (`gatewayOrderId`, `gatewayPaymentId`, `gatewaySignature`) to transition `AWAITING_PAYMENT` → `PLACED`.

item.name: Payment Gateway Webhooks
item.description: Public server-to-server webhook receivers (`noauth`) for simulating local `dev` payment callbacks (`/webhooks/payments/stub`) or processing HMAC-verified `X-Razorpay-Signature` events (`/webhooks/payments/razorpay`).

item.name: Customer Reviews
item.description: Submit, update, list, or delete 1–5 star customer reviews for completed (`DELIVERED`) orders (one review per order).

item.name: In-App Notifications
item.description: Fetch, count unread, and mark polymorphic joined-inheritance in-app notifications as read (`OrderNotification`, `PaymentNotification`, `RestaurantApplicationNotification`, `DeliveryAgentApplicationNotification`, `VehicleApplicationNotification`, `CuisineNotification`).

item.name: Presigned S3 File Uploads
item.description: Generate short-lived presigned AWS S3 `PUT` URLs (`uploadUrl` + `fileUrl`) for direct client uploads (`RESTAURANT_IMAGE`, `RESTAURANT_DOCUMENT`).
